name: @matatbread/matbot-background-jobs-node
description: Node background jobs: @matatbread/matbot-background-jobs with each job run in its own process — a hard boundary that can be killed, at the cost of a full boot per run.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "process.env.MATBOT_PUBLISH_ALL || (console.error('Refused: publish with pnpm publish-all from the repo root. It checks versions, contents and the web bundle first.'), process.exit(1))"
